description: Gureje et al. found Nigerians had lower somatization prevalence than Latin American comparators. The picture is not uniform and this row records the disagreement rather than choosing the more dramatic figure.
Presenting with chest pain, then abdominal pain, then headache produces successive negative workups, each with a fee, in a pay-at-point-of-use system.
energy_note: Four investigations, all negative, all paid for in cash.
